scope: Relevant public polymer dynamics, looping, microcompartment and coupled transcription primary studies; not an assertion that every laboratory publication or raw file was downloaded.

datasets.title: Dynamics of CTCF- and cohesin-mediated chromatin looping revealed by live-cell imaging
datasets.observable: 3D two-locus relative-vector MSD, pair distance distribution, inferred looping statistics
datasets.access: Downloaded all11 filtered original TSVs; downloaded exact author H5 with all12conditions. No unfiltered/raw microscopy data downloaded.
datasets.analysis_status: All12conditions derived separately;17curve variants; RAD212h movie-held-out split; localization correction only baseline.
datasets.baseline_role: RAD212h training subset; mechanistic baseline assumption of no loop extrusion. Other conditions retained for validation.
limitations: WAPL6h only in H5 re-deposit; no movie IDs available for that condition.
Seven duplicate frame rows across three TSVs resolved by last row, verified against the author H5.
Full relative MSD, not half relative MSD or individual-locus MSD.
The same reused Fbn2 data appearing in newer archives are not independent replication.

datasets.title: Genome-wide absolute quantification of chromatin looping
datasets.observable: Micro-C dot strength versus absolute looping probability; structural contact-decay curve; re-deposited Fbn2 trajectories
datasets.analysis_status: H5 used to verify and supplement Fbn2. Structural CSVs inventoried, not fitted.
datasets.baseline_role: Structural validation and source model reproduction; its70,000monomer calibration clock cannot be transferred to this engine.
limitations: Files named polysim_calibration_curve calibrate contact/loop probabilities, not MSD/time.
No matched raw simulated calibration trajectory was located in this public deposit.
Fbn2 H5 is reused Gabriele2022 experimental data, not a new independent dataset.

datasets.title: Integrated MINFLUX tracking reveals two distinct chromatin dynamics classes across cell types
datasets.observable: MINFLUX short-time chromatin tracks; camera SPT pair-relative MSD; long-time Fbn2 SRLCI; model-inferred MSDs
datasets.access: Public archive metadata inspected. Processed data.zip823593800bytes and data_revision.zip1083825604bytes were not downloaded; raw microscopy archives also excluded from this small-component audit.
datasets.analysis_status: Not reanalyzed; future independent cell-type and short-time validation.
datasets.baseline_role: Tests whether a Rouse-like/coarse Markovian polymer can reproduce slopes across time and cell states; not pooled withFbn2.
limitations: Paper SPT processing may report half the two-point MSD as an individual-motion proxy; match the precise observable rather than applying a silent factor2.
Cell types, labeling and perturbations have distinct dynamics.
Fbn2 reuse is not independent ofGabriele2022.
Finite exposure and localization noise dominate some fast lags; use published observation model.

datasets.title: Dynamics of microcompartment formation at the mitosis-to-G1 transition
datasets.observable: Region-capture Micro-C contact maps through cell-cycle stages and condensin depletion; matching polymer simulations

units.simulation: 0.5kb per modeled site in source study

datasets.access: Open-access primary data statement and code README verified; no contact matrix downloaded in this pass.
datasets.license: Check GEO file terms; simulation repo has its own license
datasets.analysis_status: Not reanalyzed; structural and temporal holdout after cell-type-specific parameterization.
datasets.baseline_role: Constrains compartment attractions, loop-extrusion competition and contact formation; not an independent free-polymer diffusion clock.
limitations: Mouse erythroid cell state differs from Fbn2 mESC baseline.
M-to-G1 progression is nonstationary; cannot pool into an equilibrium MSD fit.

datasets.title: Live-cell imaging of enhancer-promoter dynamics reveals transient contact-driven gene activation
datasets.observable: Paired enhancer-promoter distance and MS2 nascent transcription, multiple designed spacings andCTCF/cohesin perturbations
datasets.access: Archive64file metadata inspected; individual processedNPZ/CSV files are small enough for selective retrieval. No trajectory file downloaded in this pass.
datasets.analysis_status: Future coupled transcription/geometry validation; protocol audited by parallel protein/transcription review.
datasets.baseline_role: Coupled E-P/transcription holdout distinct from Fbn2 clock fitting.
limitations: Preprint; engineered locus and labeled spacings need exact design matching.
Filename nominal distances340/255/170/85kb differ from actualdesigned339/253/170/87kb.
Contact, nascent-RNA reporter and kinetic model observation conventions must match.

fit_policy: Separate conditions, cell states and observables; designate training and held-out observations before parameter fitting; never infer protein rate constants from a polymer clock alone.
